summary: Frontend-only validation of the new period selector (7d / 30d / 90d / YTD) in OverdueEvolutionChart on /finance. All 12 requested acceptance criteria passed: buttons render with correct labels and data-testids, default 30d is aria-pressed, clicking each period emits GET /api/finance/overdue-evolution with the correct days parameter, aria-pressed toggles correctly (only active button pressed), summary card labels update to '(7d)/(30d)/(90d)/(YTD)', YTD sends a dynamic days value (observed 201 for current preview date), rapid successive clicks resolve to the last selected period (AbortController effective — no stale state), chart re-renders with data on 30d/90d/YTD windows, trend label persists, and sidebar links (Cobranças Hoje, Clientes Finance) remain navigable.
critical_code_review_comments: OverdueEvolutionChart.js: YTD computation is done once at render (inside an IIFE at component-body level) — it will drift if the tab stays open across midnight on Dec 31 → Jan 1. Not blocking, cosmetic only.

The chart summary strip is hidden when series.length < 2, which is the correct guard but means the 7d window shows the empty-state message in the current preview DB (data only exists at 2026-07-01 / 07-02, today is 2026-07-20). Functionally correct; may confuse users who expect the label to still change to (7d). Consider showing the period selector separately from the empty state.

Two duplicate initial GETs to /api/finance/overdue-evolution?days=30 are fired on mount (likely React 18 StrictMode dev double-invoke or a parent re-render). Not a bug in production build but worth confirming the parent doesn't remount the child.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing preview DB (2 data points at 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-02).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Period selector data-testids: period-selector (wrapper), period-7 / period-30 / period-90 / period-ytd (buttons). aria-pressed reflects active. Summary cards labels contain '(7d)' / '(30d)' / '(90d)' / '(YTD)'. When series.length<2 (e.g. 7d window with no data), summary strip is intentionally hidden — assert summary labels only on periods where preview DB has data (30d/90d/YTD in current preview). Observed YTD days value at test time: 201 (browser date 2026-07-20).
